title: Robinson Crusoe: Adventures on the Cursed Island
publicSourceReferences: Portal Games Official Robinson Crusoe Rulebook & Scenario Compendium
Community Campaign Logs & Survival Failure Rate Statistics

milestones.title: Castaways
milestones.description: Shipwrecked on the desolate coast, survivors construct emergency shelter, forage for food, and amass timber for a towering signal beacon before autumn storms strike.

milestones.title: Cursed Island
milestones.description: Unnatural mists shroud the island as malevolent spirits awaken; the castaways must erect consecrated markers and perform solemn rituals to cleanse the cursed grounds.

milestones.title: Jenny Needs Help!
milestones.description: A companion clings to survival across treacherous offshore reefs; the crew gathers driftwood, builds a seaworthy raft, and braves shark-infested currents.

milestones.title: Volcano Island
milestones.description: Violent earth tremors shake the interior as the volcano awakens, triggering a frantic scramble to harvest materials and construct escape canoes before lava engulfs the shores.

milestones.title: Cannibal Island
milestones.description: Hostile tribal warriors encircle the shoreline; the survivors fortify palisades, fashion lethal traps, and launch strategic incursions to disarm native war camps.

milestones.title: Family Robinson
milestones.description: Resigned to permanent settlement, the castaways clear arable farmland, domesticate native livestock, and construct enduring fortifications against the wild elements.

milestones.title: King Kong Island
milestones.description: Beyond the monumental stone perimeter wall, survivors venture into prehistoric lowlands to track, capture, and safely secure the legendary towering island titan.
